summary_md:
**Xi Chen ([@YCX15385071](https://x.com/YCX15385071/status/2115004953001607334))** announces the **Auto-Research Arena** paper, which asks what AI research agents can discover when optimizing for nine different objectives (model size, inference speed, etc.) rather than just validation loss, and evaluates both the research *harnesses* and their discoveries.

In the [follow-up](https://x.com/YCX15385071/status/2115004954817802520), Chen reports the agents produced 32 findings in 9 idea families; a new search that recombines these ideas (1-hour training per candidate) yields a model with lower loss than the baseline using less compute and data. The attached figure ranks harnesses by Elo — simple sequential search places second, while a narrowly tuned method (TPE) places last.
